# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is overwhelmingly **operational/internal chatter** — MTC/test-certificate (TC) follow-ups with site engineers, tag/batch mismatches, crane/loading coordination, coil-cutting instructions to operators, payment-reconciliation calls, and (in the "Vishal" threads) personal/family conversations unrelated to business. Only a modest subset of calls are genuine sales conversations — rate enquiries, stock checks, brand clarifications, and price negotiations with dealers/fabricators/contractors. The sales signal that does exist is consistent enough to extract real patterns, but this KB should be read as a **thin sample**, not a comprehensive sales playbook. Figures and terms below are taken verbatim/paraphrased from the real calls; nothing is invented.

## Products & brand ladder

From the sales-relevant calls, BSC deals primarily in **long and flat steel products**, sourced from major mills and resold/processed:

- **TMT rebar** — grades **FE 500D** and **550D**; brands referenced: **Sail**, **Vaisakh**, **RINL/Vizag (RNL)**. Customers often ask specifically "**Vizag tag** வந்திருக்கா SAIL tag வந்திருக்கா" [did it come with Vizag tag or SAIL tag]. One call clarifies: "**500 கிடைக்காது sir... அவங்க இப்ப 3 months-ஆ R&L production இல்ல**" [500 grade not available, RINL hasn't produced it for 3 months] — so **550D is the practical default** when 500D is requested.
- **MS Plates / Checkered plates** — thickness range 2mm–25mm+, standard sheet sizes 2500×6300mm / "**full-ஆவே 6300 தான்**" [only 6300 length kept in stock]; cut sizes generally **not done** for plates ("**Flats-லாம் நம்ம cut பண்றது கிடையாது**").
